import csv

traces_dir = "results/a5/traces"

# Check: do different seeds produce different final objectives? \(independence\)
print\("Final objectives by seed \(should differ\):\\n"\)
for domain in ["SAT", "BinPacking", "PersonnelScheduling"]:
    print\(f"{domain}:"\)
    for technique in ["SP-CF-LA", "SP-SR-LA", "MP-CF"]:
        vals = []
        for seed in [42, 123]:
            path = f"{traces_dir}/trace_{technique}_{domain}_0_{seed}.csv"
            try:
                with open\(path\) as f:
                    rows = list\(csv.DictReader\(f\)\)
                    bsf = float\(rows[-1]["best_so_far"]\)
                    vals.append\(f"seed {seed}: {bsf:.4f}"\)
            except:
                vals.append\(f"seed {seed}: MISSING"\)
        print\(f"  {technique:15s}  {' | '.join\(vals\)}"\)
    print\(\)
PYEOF)
